about_the_game:
Stunted Gravity is a hovercraft stunt-driving game where up and down won’t sit still. Arenas twist the rules: gravity flips, redirects, and flows—turning every course into a puzzle you can hit at full speed.

This is the Stunted Gravity Circuit: tight handling, bold energy, and scoring that rewards precision and style. One clean line becomes a highlight; one perfect landing becomes momentum. Tag courses with paint, thread stunt rings, route through hazards, survive robot attacks, and push for those Titanium-clean runs that feel like magic.

Highlights

  • Shifting gravity, one skillset: learn the driving maneuvers that hold up even as the world changes beneath you.

  • Stunts that matter: grades and timing that elevate clean driving without breaking the flow.

  • Hostile arenas: hazards, traps, and bots that force creative lines instead of single “right” routes.

  • Built for replay: fast restarts and awards tuned for “one more run.”

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04+ (or glibc-compatible 64-bit distro)
  • Processor: 4-core CPU (Intel Core i5-7500 / Ryzen 3 1200 or better)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan-capable GPU (Vulkan 1.1+). Example: Intel UHD 630 / Radeon Vega 8 / GeForce GTX 960
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Includes in-game graphics options; playable on modern integrated graphics at reduced settings.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04+ (or glibc-compatible 64-bit distro)
  • Processor: 6-core CPU (Intel Core i5-10400 / Ryzen 5 3600 or better)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1650 / GTX 1060, Radeon RX 570 / RX 580, or better (Vulkan 1.2 driver)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Stunted Gravity is a hovercraft stunt-driving game set in a neon-dystopian future. Race, jump, and improvise lines across arenas where gravity pulls in any and every direction. Execute stunts, evade hazards, and battle enemy drones as you pilot though the interplanetary Stunted Gravity Circuit.
